title: LedgerEvent
description: SPEC-004 append-only, hash-chained Execution Ledger event. hash = sha256(prev_hash || canonicalJSON(event without hash)); the first event of a run chains from 64 zero hex digits. Exactly one of payload (inline JSON, <= 1 MiB canonical UTF-8) or payload_ref (CAS blob holding the canonical JSON bytes) is non-null. Payloads are open objects so a new adapter needs no schema change. intent_id (SPEC-015 amendment 2) is top-level and part of the hashed event; every event the ledger appends carries it (string or null). It is not required, because events sealed before the amendment do not have the member and are never re-hashed.

seq.description: Strictly increasing and contiguous per run, starting at 1.

intent_id.description: Correlates a request (tool.requested, side_effect.requested) with its acknowledgement or failure, even when the payload is offloaded. Mapped from Claude Code tool_use_id.

anyOf.description: Payload over 1 MiB, stored as a blob.
